data.gender_notes: Nijarat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Najr', meaning 'victory' or 'conquering'. This name signifies triumph and strength, both in the physical and spiritual realms. The name Nijarat carries the meaning “Victorious, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nijarat usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nijarat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
